commands: juju ssh --container <workload-container> <unit>/0 -- pebble notify canonical.com/mycharm/test-notice key=value
expected: A pebble-custom-notice event fires for the charm to observe, regardless of whether the notice was recorded by root or by the unprivileged _daemon_ user.
observed: Per the reporter: no event fires for notices recorded by a non-root UID, because Pebble scopes them to that user and Juju only surfaces public (root-recorded) notices.
